shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Separate the writing surface from the cool canvas.

components.name: Studio sheet
components.description: The single writing and playback surface.
components.css: .ds-sheet { background: #fff; color: #172c3a; border-radius: 12px; padding: 2rem; box-shadow: 0 16px 45px rgba(28, 53, 70, .08); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Writing area
components.description: Tall Arabic text input inside the studio sheet.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-editor" dir="rtl" aria-label="النص العربي" placeholder="اكتب النص الذي تريد سماعه…"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-editor { background: #f7f9fa; color: #172c3a; border: 1px solid #dce5ea; padding: 1rem; min-height: 240px; width: 100%; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.9; } .ds-editor:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2254b4; }

narrative.overview: A cool, quiet writing space puts Arabic text at the center of voice generation. The writing sheet separates the task from the surrounding canvas; the playback area belongs to the same surface. Controls stay familiar and secondary settings recede into popovers.
dos: Do preserve Arabic RTL and the Thmanyah font throughout the workspace.
Do keep generation, listening, and downloading within one visible task surface.
donts: Don't spread seed controls or explanatory paragraphs across the main workflow.
